fix.summary: Simber skips CancellationException (direct or as cause) from Crashlytics reporting, and EventUpSyncTask rethrows cancellation instead of recording the operation as FAILED

items.root_cause: Broad catch blocks in sync paths log WorkManager cancellations via Simber.e, which records them as non-fatals: FirebaseAuthManager.getCurrentToken ("Failed to get access token"), EventRepositoryImpl.reportException ("Failed to save the event") and EventUpSyncTask ("Failed to upload event scopes"). EventUpSyncTask also swallows the CancellationException (not in isTerminalException) and records the scope as FAILED. Unchanged on main; Simber.shouldSkipThrowableReporting could skip CancellationException, and EventUpSyncTask should rethrow it. No open PR.

fix.summary: Treat RLM_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT_VERSION like DB corruption so RealmWrapperImpl deletes and recreates the unupgradable legacy Realm file

items.root_cause: A single device has a legacy Realm file in format 9 that realm-kotlin cannot upgrade. RealmWrapperImpl.createRealm only deletes and recreates the DB on RLM_ERR_INVALID_DATABASE, not RLM_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT_VERSION, so every background worker fails. Main is unchanged.

fix.summary: Synchronize core FirebaseAuth lookup and core FirebaseApp deletion in FirebaseAuthManager so getCurrentToken can't use an app being deleted by signOut/re-init

items.root_cause: There is a race in FirebaseAuthManager: signOut/initializeCoreProject delete the core FirebaseApp (tryToDeleteCoreApp) while a sync worker calls FirebaseAuth.getInstance(getCoreApp()) in getCurrentToken, which throws "FirebaseApp was deleted". The worker fails gracefully. getCoreApp is still unsynchronised against delete on main.

issues.root_cause: Last log line is "[FACE_CAPTURE] Image analysis cancelled": LiveFeedbackFragment.setUpFrameProcessing catches the expected CancellationException when the capture screen is left after Finish capture, logs it with Simber.e (so it is recorded as a non-fatal) and rethrows it correctly. Harmless, but downgrading that log to Simber.i would remove the noise. Same code on main; no open PR.

issues.root_cause: Firebase Auth token refresh fails with a generic FirebaseException wrapping an IO error (connection abort). FirebaseAuthManager.transformFirebaseExceptionIfNeeded maps only FirebaseNetworkException/ApiException to NetworkConnectionException, so it is logged via Simber.e and the worker retries. This is a handled network blip; on main it is still not classified as a network error.

issues.root_cause: CommCare (eCHIS) sends CONFIRM_IDENTITY when there is no open session with an identification callback (e.g. after a failed login, an exit form or a reboot closed it), so SID creates an empty session and ConfirmIdentityValidator correctly rejects the request. The non-fatal is deliberate (MS-1214). Same logic on main; no open PR.
issues.title: com.simprints.feature.clientapi.mappers.request.validators.ConfirmIdentityValidator.validateSessionEvents
issues.warning: eCHIS CommCare form maintainers should only send Confirm Identity after a successful Simprints Identify in the same session.
